reading.zh: 两条路共用一套换算：浮层只负责把人画出来的屏幕矩形交出来；把它翻译成 probe 认得的坐标系、并给出可粘贴的命令，由 placement 的一条规则决定（客户区 → 窗口 → 无）。
reading.en: Both paths share one conversion: the overlay only hands over the screen rectangle a human drew; turning it into a space probe accepts, and printing a paste-ready command, is placement single rule (client, then window, then nothing).
